title: The Space Race
summary: Two superpowers competed to reach the heavens — from Sputnik's beep to bootprints on the lunar surface.

stories.title: To the Moon
stories.summary: Five milestones from the first satellite to Apollo 11.

events.title: Sputnik 1
events.body: The Soviet Union launched the world's first artificial satellite. Its radio beep from orbit shocked Americans and opened the space age.

events.title: Gagarin's Flight
events.body: Yuri Gagarin orbited Earth aboard Vostok 1, becoming the first human in space. The feat galvanised Kennedy's pledge to land Americans on the Moon before 1970.

events.title: Apollo 8 Around the Moon
events.body: Apollo 8 became the first crewed mission to leave Earth orbit and circle the Moon. The crew's Christmas Eve broadcast and Earthrise photograph captivated the world.

events.title: Apollo 11 Landing
events.body: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Eagle in the Sea of Tranquility. Armstrong's first step fulfilled Kennedy's goal and marked humanity's greatest voyage of exploration.

events.title: Splashdown & Return
events.body: The command module Columbia splashed down in the Pacific. The crew entered quarantine and returned to ticker-tape parades — the space race's decisive American victory.

stories.title: The Shuttle Era
stories.summary: Reusable spacecraft and the space station age.
